title: Structural basis for control of integrative and conjugative element excision and transfer by the oligomeric winged helix-turn-helix protein RdfS.
authors: Verdonk, Callum J; Agostino, Mark; Eto, Karina Yui; Hall, Drew A; Bond, Charles S; Ramsay, Joshua P
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构、分子动力学模拟和功能实验，揭示wHTH蛋白RdfS通过新型α1螺旋寡聚化以间接读取机制识别低序列保守的DNA区域，调控整合性接合元件切除与转移，属于TF-DNA类蛋白-DNA互作机制的结构与动态建模研究，与课题高度匹配。
abstract: Winged helix-turn-helix (wHTH) proteins are diverse DNA-binding proteins that often oligomerize on DNA and participate in DNA recombination and transcriptional regulation. wHTH recombination directionality factors (RDFs) associated with tyrosine recombinases, stimulate excision of prophage and integrative and conjugative elements (ICEs). RdfS is required for excision and conjugation of the Mesorhizobium japonicum R7A ICE, ICEMlSymR7A, which carries genes for nitrogen-fixing symbiosis. We show RdfS binds to DNA regions within the IntS attachment site (attP) and within the rdfS promoter, enabling RdfS to coordinate rdfS/intS expression and stimulate RdfS/IntS-mediated ICEMlSymR7A excision. Several RdfS DNA-binding sites were identified. However, no consensus motif was apparent and no individual nucleotide substitutions in attP prevented RdfS binding. RdfS forms extensive helical filaments in crystals, with subunits contacting via a novel alpha1-helix absent in other wHTH-RDFs. RdfS oligomerized in solution in the absence of DNA. Molecular dynamics simulations supported a role for the alpha1-helix in oligomerization and compaction of nucleoprotein complexes. Removal of RdfS-alpha1 did not eliminate DNA-binding in vitro but reduced oligomerization and abolished RdfS-mediated ICEMlSymR7A excision and conjugative transfer. We propose the novel RdfS-alpha1 mediated oligomerization enables RdfS to specifically recognize larger DNA regions with low primary sequence conservation through an indirect readout mechanism.
abstract_zh: winged helix-turn-helix (wHTH) 蛋白是多样的DNA结合蛋白，常在DNA上寡聚化，并参与DNA重组和转录调控。与酪氨酸重组酶相关的wHTH重组方向性因子（RDFs）刺激前噬菌体及整合性接合元件（ICEs）的切除。RdfS是日本中生根瘤菌（Mesorhizobium japonicum）R7A ICE（ICEMlSymR7A）切除和接合所必需的，该ICE携带固氮共生基因。我们显示RdfS结合于IntS附着位点（attP）内的DNA区域以及rdfS启动子内，使RdfS能够协调rdfS/intS表达并刺激RdfS/IntS介导的ICEMlSymR7A切除。鉴定了多个RdfS DNA结合位点。然而，未发现明显的共有基序，且attP中的单个核苷酸替换均未阻止RdfS结合。RdfS在晶体中形成广泛的螺旋丝状结构，亚基通过其他wHTH-RDFs中缺失的新型alpha1螺旋接触。RdfS在无DNA情况下于溶液中寡聚化。分子动力学模拟支持alpha1螺旋在寡聚化和核蛋白复合物压缩中的作用。去除RdfS-alpha1并未消除体外DNA结合，但减少了寡聚化，并 abolished RdfS介导的ICEMlSymR7A切除和接合转移。我们提出，新型RdfS-alpha1介导的寡聚化使RdfS能够通过间接读取机制特异性识别具有低初级序列保守性的较大DNA区域。
